title: Incorrect proxy address tracking misconfigures USDXL pool tokens
summary: ## Severity  **Impact:** Medium  **Likelihood:** High  ## Description  The `DeployUsdxlUtils._getUsdxlATokenProxy()` and `DeployUsdxlUtils._getUsdxlVariableDebtTokenProxy()` functions incorrectly return implementation contract addresses instead of proxy addresses.  ```solidity //File: src/deployments/utils/DeployUsdxlUtils.sol  function _getUsdxlATokenProxy() internal view returns (address) {     return address(usdxlAToken);    // Returns implementation instead of proxy }  function _getUsdxlVariableDebtTokenProxy() internal view returns (address) {     return address(usdxlVariableDebtToken); /
